question: Which works did Fatima Alam Ali write? Follow the WROTE relationship from the Author node.
cypher: MATCH (a:Author {name: "Fatima Alam Ali"})-[:WROTE]->(w:Work) RETURN w.title AS title
notes: AMBIGUITY: w.author string vs WROTE relationship. Question pins the relationship path explicitly.

question: Who is the author of the work titled 'Aiwan-e-Ghazal'?
cypher: MATCH (a:Author)-[:WROTE]->(w:Work {title: "Aiwan-e-Ghazal"}) RETURN a.name AS name
notes: Jeelani Bano.

question: List the names of every genre in the database.
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre) RETURN g.name AS name
notes: Vocabulary is messy (Short Story vs Short Stories) but the listing itself is unambiguous.

question: Which works were published in the magazine 'Andhra Jyoti'?
cypher: MATCH (w:Work)-[:PUBLISHED_IN]->(m:Magazine {name: "Andhra Jyoti"}) RETURN w.title AS title
notes: AMBIGUITY: 4 works carry w.magazine with no PUBLISHED_IN relationship.

question: Which authors write in Urdu? Use the USES_LANGUAGE relationship.
cypher: MATCH (a:Author)-[:USES_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language {name: "Urdu"}) RETURN a.name AS name
notes: Author.language property agrees here; 1 author has the property but no relationship.

question: What other works were written by the author of 'Aiwan-e-Ghazal'? Exclude 'Aiwan-e-Ghazal' itself.
cypher: MATCH (:Work {title: "Aiwan-e-Ghazal"})<-[:WROTE]-(a:Author)-[:WROTE]->(w:Work) WHERE w.title <> "Aiwan-e-Ghazal" RETURN w.title AS title
notes: Two-hop through a shared Author. Jeelani Bano has 3 works total.

question: Which authors have written at least one work in the 'Short Story' genre? Use the HAS_GENRE relationship.
cypher: MATCH (a:Author)-[:WROTE]->(w:Work)-[:HAS_GENRE]->(:Genre {name: "Short Story"}) RETURN DISTINCT a.name AS name
notes: Three-hop. AMBIGUITY: a separate 'Short Stories' Genre node also exists; question pins the exact name.

question: Which works are tagged with the keyword 'Hyderabad'? Keywords are a string array property on Work; match case-insensitively.
cypher: MATCH (w:Work) WHERE any(k IN w.keywords WHERE toLower(trim(k)) = "hyderabad") RETURN w.title AS title
notes: Tests knowing keywords is an array property, not a node.

question: Which works have more than 50 keywords?
cypher: MATCH (w:Work) WHERE size(w.keywords) > 50 RETURN w.title AS title
notes: size() on an array property.

question: Which works have a year that is exactly four digits and earlier than 1950? Ignore works whose year is missing, empty, or not a plain four-digit number.
cypher: MATCH (w:Work) WHERE w.year IS NOT NULL AND w.year =~ '\\d{4}' AND toInteger(w.year) < 1950 RETURN w.title AS title, w.year AS year
notes: AMBIGUITY DELIBERATELY PINNED: year is a STRING with values like '1944-11-05', 'Not Dated', 'Various Years', '1926-1929', ''. Only 43 of 162 are clean 4-digit. Question states the rule so the gold is well-defined.

question: Which magazines have published work by an author who writes in Telugu?
cypher: MATCH (a:Author)-[:USES_LANGUAGE]->(:Language {name: "Telugu"}) MATCH (a)-[:WROTE]->(:Work)-[:PUBLISHED_IN]->(m:Magazine) RETURN DISTINCT m.name AS name
notes: Four-hop across three relationship types.

question: Which works appeared in the same magazine as 'Mohini'? Exclude 'Mohini' itself.
cypher: MATCH (:Work {title: "Mohini"})-[:PUBLISHED_IN]->(m:Magazine)<-[:PUBLISHED_IN]-(w:Work) WHERE w.title <> "Mohini" RETURN w.title AS title
notes: Sibling traversal through a shared Magazine.

question: Which works share at least one keyword with 'Aiwan-e-Ghazal'? Exclude 'Aiwan-e-Ghazal' itself. Compare keywords case-insensitively.
cypher: MATCH (t:Work {title: "Aiwan-e-Ghazal"}) WITH [k IN t.keywords | toLower(trim(k))] AS target MATCH (w:Work) WHERE w.title <> "Aiwan-e-Ghazal" AND any(k IN w.keywords WHERE toLower(trim(k)) IN target) RETURN DISTINCT w.title AS title
notes: Array intersection. This is the pattern the app's own prompt teaches.

question: How many works has each author written? Return the five authors with the most works, highest first, with the count.
cypher: MATCH (a:Author)-[:WROTE]->(w:Work) RETURN a.name AS name, count(w) AS works ORDER BY works DESC, name ASC LIMIT 5
notes: AMBIGUITY: ties at the boundary. Gold adds name ASC as a deterministic tiebreak. Fatima Alam Ali 12, P.Satyavati 11, Kuppili Padma 6, then a 5-way tie at 5.

question: How many works are linked to each genre? Return the genre name and the count.
cypher: MATCH (w:Work)-[:HAS_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN g.name AS name, count(w) AS works
notes: 9 of 10 Genre nodes have works. AMBIGUITY: 10 works have w.genre with no HAS_GENRE relationship, so property-based counting differs.

question: How many authors are associated with each language?
cypher: MATCH (a:Author)-[:USES_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) RETURN l.name AS name, count(a) AS authors
notes: Telugu 83, Urdu 3. One author has no relationship.

question: Among works that have at least one keyword, what is the average number of keywords per work? Round to two decimal places.
cypher: MATCH (w:Work) WHERE size(w.keywords) > 0 RETURN round(avg(size(w.keywords)), 2) AS avgKeywords
notes: AMBIGUITY: 104 of 162 works have an empty array. Question restricts to non-empty so the denominator is pinned at 58.

question: Which authors have written works in more than one distinct genre? Return the author name and the number of distinct genres.
cypher: MATCH (a:Author)-[:WROTE]->(:Work)-[:HAS_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH a, count(DISTINCT g) AS genres WHERE genres > 1 RETURN a.name AS name, genres
notes: HARD: requires grouping before filtering (WITH ... WHERE), not a bare WHERE.

question: Find pairs of distinct works that share three or more keywords. Compare case-insensitively and return each pair only once, with the number of shared keywords.
cypher: MATCH (a:Work), (b:Work) WHERE a.title < b.title AND size(a.keywords) > 0 AND size(b.keywords) > 0 WITH a, b, [k IN a.keywords | toLower(trim(k))] AS ka, [k IN b.keywords | toLower(trim(k))] AS kb WITH a, b, size([k IN ka WHERE k IN kb]) AS shared WHERE shared >= 3 RETURN a.title AS workA, b.title AS workB, shared ORDER BY shared DESC
notes: HARD: self-join over array properties, de-duplicated with a.title < b.title. CAVEAT: that de-duplication also drops any pair of works sharing an identical title (the duplicate 'Mundadugu' nodes), since a.title < b.title is false for them. Cartesian product over 162 works is fine at this scale but would not be at 10k.

question: Which works have an author name recorded in their author property but are not connected to any Author node by a WROTE relationship?
cypher: MATCH (w:Work) WHERE w.author IS NOT NULL AND trim(w.author) <> "" AND NOT ( (:Author)-[:WROTE]->(w) ) RETURN w.title AS title, w.author AS author
notes: HARD: tests understanding that the schema stores authorship twice and the two disagree. Requires a negated pattern predicate.
